title: Continuum command manifest
description: An authored command: a verb backed by a process on this machine. Drop the file in <continuum_root>/commands/ — it is live on the next boot, no deploy, no repo change.

access.description: `ai_safe` (a citizen may call it; the ACL maps it to Provisional trust) or `privileged` (operator and substrate only).

description.description: One line, model-facing: what the persona's tool surface shows the reasoner.

exec.description: argv. The first element resolves on PATH or as a path relative to the manifest.

name.description: The verb, e.g. `ext/proof-check`. Must not collide with a shipped command.

native.description: Opt into the persona's NATIVE tool surface (offered as a tool schema, not merely reachable by name). Keep the native set small; see `native_tool_specs`.

params.description: JSON Schema for the params object. The recipe gate validates steps against it and `commands/help` renders it — declare it, or the verb is untyped.

timeoutMs.description: Every process call is bounded and named. Default 60 000 ms.

ManifestCwd.description: Where an authored command's process runs.

oneOf.description: The calling citizen's workspace when known, else the root.

ManifestWire.description: How params reach the process and the result comes back.

oneOf.description: Params as one JSON document on stdin; stdout is the JSON result. The default.
A long-lived process holding one connection. Declared, not yet built: a manifest naming it is refused at load with that reason.
